description.value: Codes returned by the CMS Integrated Outpatient Code Editor (I/OCE) for a claim line to indicate whether the line has been denied or rejected as a result of I/OCE editing, or flagged for informational purposes only. CMS defines and maintains these codes as the I/OCE Line-item Denial or Rejection Flag, not HL7. This value set includes all values listed for the Line-item Denial or Rejection Flag in the APC Return Buffer Table of the I/OCE Specifications for the applicable release.
